main_text.p: Autor defectionis fuit Henricus Dux Glogoviensis qui se, & omnes Silefiorum Ducatus, quorum 17, in clientelam Johannis Regis Bohemiæ, atq; ita imperio, tradidit: neq; ab eo tempore Poloni Silefiam recuperare potuerunt.
main_text.head: Poloniæ Lithuania accessit.
main_text.p: (ʒ)[?] Auctio per Lithuaniam.A. C. 1368. Quippe, extincta familia Piasti Poloni, Jagellonem, Magnum Ducem Lithuaniæ, Regem suum crearunt, hac conditione, ut fidem Christianam amplecteretur, & Poloniæ Lithuaniam perpetuo jure conjungeret. Ita familia Jagellonidum, quæ in Poloni regnavit, extincta in Sigismundo Augusto A. C. 1570.

page.notes: The reference mark "(ʒ)" beside the first margin note is uncertain and not visible in the text. The printed "Explic." and the head "Poloniæ Lithuania accessit." are set in italic. "Borussiam" in the margin note is hyphenated across two lines as "Borus-"/"siam". The printed "Ita" opens with an unusual italic capital, read as I. No damage affects the text.
